items.headline: Google, OpenAI and Anthropic plan joint AI safety self-regulation body
items.summary: The three frontier labs announced plans to form the Standards Authority for Frontier AI (SAFA), a self-regulatory body that would set testing, auditing and incident-reporting standards for advanced AI without direct government oversight. It follows the stall of an earlier push for a public-private safety partnership.

items.headline: Sanders and Casar introduce bill to ban artificial superintelligence
items.summary: Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Greg Casar introduced the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act, which would permanently prohibit AI systems exceeding human cognitive performance, pause advanced AI development pending federal safety rules, and create a new cabinet-level Department of Artificial Intelligence, with violators facing steep corporate and criminal penalties.

items.headline: Anthropic says Claude autonomously discovered a novel CRISPR-like enzyme system
items.summary: In a 21.5-hour autonomous research campaign searching roughly 1.9 billion protein clusters, Claude identified a previously undescribed enzyme system in bacteriophage DNA featuring repeat arrays reminiscent of CRISPR, a finding CRISPR pioneer Feng Zhang called 'genuinely intriguing.' Anthropic says it has not yet determined the system's function.

items.headline: Meta unveils Muse Charm, a Tamagotchi-style AI companion device
items.summary: At Meta Connect, Zuckerberg introduced the Muse Charm, a puck-sized wearable with a two-inch screen showing a customizable animated avatar for chatting with Meta's Muse AI agent independent of a phone or smart glasses. Meta says the device, which includes cameras, mics and 5G, is slated to ship by December.

items.headline: Google makes Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar generally available
items.summary: Gemini 3.8 Live now offers a real-time video 'Live Avatar' feature for Gemini Enterprise agents, generating lip-synced, expressive animated personas across 97 languages while the agent talks and calls tools in the background. All generated audio and video carry SynthID watermarks for transparency.

items.headline: Dataiku launches Agent Management to govern enterprise AI agents
items.summary: Dataiku unveiled a standalone product that inventories AI agents across platforms like AWS, Databricks, Google, Microsoft and Salesforce, tracks their business and technical performance, and flags high-risk agents, addressing a gap where most enterprises lack a complete inventory of their AI systems.

items.headline: Ando emerges from stealth with agent-native team messaging platform and $20M seed
items.summary: Ando launched a Slack-like messaging platform built for AI agents to participate as first-class team members alongside humans, with $20 million in seed funding from Accel, Index Ventures and Emergence Capital. The platform is agent-agnostic, letting teams bring existing tools like Claude and Codex into shared channels.

items.headline: NIQ: majority of US consumers now use AI tools to shop
items.summary: NielsenIQ's Agentic Commerce Tracker found 51% of US consumers used at least one AI-powered shopping tool in the past month, crossing the halfway mark for the first time, with AI product recommendations (20%) and personal shopping assistants (16%) the most common uses.

items.headline: Alibaba cuts Qwen voice API prices by up to 95% with new Qwen-Audio 3.1 stack
items.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team released Qwen-Audio 3.1, a five-model voice lineup covering speech recognition, text-to-speech and realtime interaction, while slashing API pricing: ASR costs drop up to 95%, TTS about 70%, and realtime voice roughly 85%.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5.5 at lower cost than Opus 5
items.summary: Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 5.5, pricing it at $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, roughly 40% cheaper than its predecessor while matching Claude Fable 5.1 on most coding and knowledge-work benchmarks.

items.headline: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6 Sol
items.summary: OpenAI released two new GPT-6 model variants, Luna and Sol, arriving within 90 minutes of Anthropic's Opus 5.5 launch in what industry watchers dubbed 'model drop week' amid an accelerating release cadence among frontier labs.

items.headline: ANYbotics robots gain badge-like access through secure doors in factory pilot
items.summary: ANYbotics, dormakaba and LEGIC Identsystems completed a successful pilot letting ANYmal quadruped inspection robots carry a digital credential and request access through controlled doors at a GE Vernova power plant in Ireland, operating for weeks without manual intervention. The partners plan to offer the access feature commercially across the ANYmal fleet.

items.headline: Insurance AI startup Strada adds browser automation for API-less carrier portals
items.summary: Strada launched a browser-automation capability letting its AI agents record and replay workflows inside web-based carrier portals and legacy insurance systems that lack APIs, with full run-time logging for audit, extending its existing voice, chat and email agent suite.
